S.FORM: == 部落地理位置 == kya qutux betunux balay na qalang, cyux maki beh qalang ni Pyasan. 部落地名由來 cingay balay qu kyabil ru tuba sraral qasa.nanu yasa lalu Tayal qasa ga Tuba.
S.PHON: ****** kja qutux βetunux βalaj na qalaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]jux maki βeħ qalaŋ ni pja[s|ɕ]an ****** [ʦ|ʨ]iŋaj βalaj qu kjaβil ru tuβa [s|ɕ]raral qa[s|ɕ]ananu ja[s|ɕ]a lalu tajal qa[s|ɕ]a ɣa tuβa
